archive_matching: Exact registry identity matching uses a bounded .crate scan plus one specifically identified nested-gzip wrapper follow-up. For the wrapper, the outer gzip was decompressed once and its bytes were verified as the exact registry checksum; those inner .crate gzip bytes were then read as a tar stream in memory, with bounded name/version manifest verification. Other wrapper bytes never count as crate checksum matches.

material_search: Bounded search for LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING/NOTICE/COPYRIGHT members, plus selected README.md/src/lib.rs evidence in the eight other exact-matched archives. Filename search is not a completeness test or legal review. README license references are partial, not license terms. Complete embedded MIT source comments are preserved as exact byte-range slices and identified as embedded.
proposed_acquisition: proposed_url applies only to missing_archive identities: no held exact-checksum .crate or specifically audited gzip-wrapped archive was found in the finite scans. This does not assert global local absence or legal compliance. Proposal only; no network request/acquisition. Suggested cap 64 MiB/object and 1 GiB aggregate, SHA-256 verify against lock before preservation.
